name: auth-boundary
description: Public landing page linking to a member area. account.html redirects to login.html (via auth.js) unless localStorage.loggedIn is '1'; login.html and members.html have properly labelled login forms with a named Sign in button and a Forgot password link; members.html shows a role=alert. challenge.html imitates a bot challenge page, is not linked from index, and the fixture server returns HTTP 403 for it.

notes.challenge-or-bot-wall: pass applies to the crawled pages. /challenge.html is served with HTTP 403 by fixtures/server.ts and contains the markers 'Just a moment...', 'Verifying you are human', 'Checking your browser before accessing', #cf-challenge-running and the noscript 'Enable JavaScript and cookies to continue'; scanning it directly must yield fail.
notes.redirect: account.html uses location.replace() from auth.js (deferred script) rather than a meta refresh, so the final URL is login.html?next=account.html.
notes.login-detection: login.html: h1 'Sign in to your account', labelled username/password inside a form with submit named 'Sign in'. members.html repeats the form inline under a role=alert.
